notes.title: New: Mailing List
notes.notes: [p]Updating on the first of each month, this mailing-list will display my monthly activities, aggregate posts and events, and offer free tidbits (scrapped music, imagery, and other collected heresies) to recipients. Signing up ensures you never miss a beat.[/p][p]Join here:[/p][p][url="https://www.brukholevin.com/mailinglist.html"]https://www.brukholevin.com/mailinglist.html[/url][/p]

notes.title: Game 'Blog' launch
notes.notes:
[p]I've started a weblog relating to Kenoma: Action Without Action. Less about the game's programming, development progress, so on, and more about the interesting stuff: the artistic decisions. Hopefully there will be a new post every week.[/p][p]You can find it on:[/p][p]tumblr: [url="https://www.tumblr.com/blog/brukholevin/"]https://www.tumblr.com/blog/brukholevin/[/url][/p][p]itch.io: [url="https://brukholevin.itch.io/kenoma-action-without-action/devlog"]https://brukholevin.itch.io/kenoma-action-without-action/devlog[/url]

Thanks for your interest![/p]
